plans.name: Silver Plan
plans.description: Plan Name & Tier: Standard. Plan Selection Logic: "Silver: A cost-effective, essential coverage plan for budget-conscious companies. The key trade-offs are the lower annual limit, a significantly lower chronic/pre-existing condition sub-limit, and 80% co-insurance for all outpatient services." Network Tiers note: "The Silver plan uses a more limited network (Tier002N), which may mean fewer or different hospital and clinic choices compared to the full networks of the Platinum and Premier plans."

exclusions: Congenital defects cover is not listed for the Silver plan (listed only for Platinum and Premier)

warnings: Tier labels disagree with the annual limits: the Premier Plan is labelled "Mid-High" but carries the highest annual limit (300,000 EGP) and chronic sub-limit (35,000 EGP), while the Platinum Plan is labelled "High" with a 200,000 EGP limit.

Rate tables stop at age band 60-64 for all three plans; no premium is stated for members aged 65 and over, although the age-limit row says members over 65 require a medical questionnaire and underwriting. No band was invented for 65+.

Medication is not given a separate limit in the document; it is stated only as part of outpatient ("prescribed medications") and inpatient ("medications") coverage, so value is left null with the outpatient co-insurance reflected (20% for Silver).
Premiums are assumed to be annual per person as printed in the row "Cost by Age (Annual Premium - EGP)"; the 10% family-member discount is recorded as a condition and not applied to the figures.
"Covers Hepatitis" was matched to the catalogue benefit "Hepatitis B & C"; the document does not specify which hepatitis types.
